records.title: Fictional vendor change and prior approval clarification
records.text: For a renewal or prior vendor arrangement, identify the agreement and whether the service, purpose, data access, subcontractors, or hosting locations changed. Submit material changes to Procurement before implementation for the required Legal, Security, and Privacy reviews. A vendor statement that its standard terms are fine does not establish company approval. Prior approval does not automatically cover a changed arrangement.
